newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker prices firm, buyers spooked.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker prices firm, buyers spooked.

text.p: Singapore bunkers firmed on tight supplies and strong crude, but higher prices thinned out enquiries, traders said.
"Everyone is spooked by the strong futures," a trader said. "Buyers are not willing to buy at such high levels."
Tight supplies of 380-cst saw offers at $111 per tonne or $4 lower than the 180 cst at $115. On Thursday, 380 cst was talked at $106-$108 with 180 cst at $110-$114.
MDO was talked in a wide range in the thin market of $185-$195 and gas oil at $203-$205, unchanged from Thursday.
